artifacts.notes: The exact complete facsimile was acquired and hashed but is not retained because its 107.4 MiB size is disproportionate to the bounded Galatians locus. The printed title page dates the volume 1864, correcting Wikimedia Commons metadata that dates it 1860. Artifact pages 233-235, carrying PG 82:479-484, were visually inspected in the facsimile; extracted OCR was used only for navigation.
artifacts.rights_basis: The 1864 volume is public domain in the United States and in life-plus-70 jurisdictions; Wikimedia Commons marks the scan public domain.
